questions.question: In which type of forests are wild donkeys and camels found in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Thorny forests and bushes**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wild donkeys and camels** in India are typically found in **Thorny forests and bushes**.
 
• These regions are characterized by **arid and semi-arid climates**, which are suitable for the survival of these animals.
 
• Thorny forests and bushes are primarily located in the **northwestern parts of India**, such as Rajasthan and Gujarat.
 
• The vegetation in these areas consists of **thorny trees, shrubs, and bushes** that can withstand harsh climatic conditions.
 
• These forests provide the necessary **habitat and food resources** for wild donkeys and camels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thorny forests** are also known as **desert vegetation** or **xerophytic vegetation**.
 
• These forests are adapted to **conserve water** and survive in low moisture conditions.
 
• Common plant species found in these forests include **acacias, cacti, and euphorbias**.
 
• The **Great Rann of Kutch** in Gujarat is a notable region where wild donkeys (Indian Wild Ass) are found.
 
• Conservation efforts are in place to protect the habitats of these species due to their ecological importance.

questions.question: What type of vegetation is represented by Sundarbans, the world's largest delta located in the Bay of Bengal?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Mangrove Forests**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sundarbans is the world's largest delta and is located in the Bay of Bengal.
 
• It is primarily characterized by its extensive mangrove forests.
 
• Mangrove forests are unique coastal forests found in tropical and subtropical regions.
 
• They are known for their complex root systems that provide stability and protection against erosion.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 Tropical Thorn Forests: These are characterized by thorny trees and shrubs found in arid regions.
 
 

 Option 2
 Montane Forests: These forests are found in mountainous regions and are characterized by a variety of species adapted to cooler climates.
 
 

 Option 3
 Mangrove Forests: These are coastal forests found in tropical and subtropical regions, known for their unique root systems.
 
 

 Option 4

questions.question: Camels are found in which type of forests in India from the following?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The thorn forest and scrubs**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Camels** are primarily found in **the thorn forest and scrubs** in India.
 
• Thorn forests and scrubs are characterized by **dry, arid conditions** and are typically found in regions like **Rajasthan**, which is known for its desert landscape.
 
• These forests consist of **thorny trees and bushes** that are well adapted to survive in **harsh, water-scarce environments**.
 
• Camels are well-suited to these conditions due to their ability to **store water and withstand high temperatures**.
 
• In contrast, other types of forests such as **Montane forests, Mangrove forests, and Tropical evergreen forests** do not provide the same suitable habitat for camels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Montane forests** are found in mountainous regions and are characterized by cooler temperatures and higher precipitation.
 
• **Mangrove forests** are coastal wetlands found in tropical and subtropical regions and are known for their salt-tolerant trees and shrubs.
 
• **Tropical evergreen forests** are dense, multi-layered forests that receive high rainfall throughout the year and are found in regions like the Western Ghats and northeastern India.
 
• Each type of forest supports different kinds of flora and fauna, adapted to the specific climatic and geographical conditions of the area.

questions.question: In which of the following regions of India is the natural habitat of White-bellied Heron largely distributed?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**northeast**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The natural habitat of White-bellied Heron is largely distributed in the North-East__.**

 __
 
• The white-bellied heron (Ardea insignis), also known as the imperial heron or great white-bellied heron, is a species of large heron known from the foothills of the eastern Himalayas in India and Bhutan to northeastern Bangladesh and Myanmar.
 
• It is mostly solitary and occurs in undisturbed riversides or wetlands.
 
• It has been listed as **Critically Endangered on the IUCN Red List** since 2007 because the global population is estimated at less than 300 mature individuals and threatened by habitat loss and human disturbance.
 
 
 
• **Northeast India** is the easternmost region of India representing both a geographic and political-administrative division of the country.
 
 
• It comprises eight states – Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Tripura, and Sikkim.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Info rmation__**

 
• **Northern plains** are the youngest physiographic feature in India.

 
 
• They lie to the south of the Shivaliks, separated by the Himalayan Frontal Fault (HFF).
 
• The southern boundary is a wavy irregular line along the northern edge of Peninsular India.
 
 
 
• The **Deccan Plateau** is a large plateau in southern India between the Western Ghats and the Eastern Ghats and is loosely defined as the peninsular region between these ranges that is south of the Narmada river.
 
• The** Western Coastal plains** are located between the Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea.
 
 
• The plains begin at Gujarat in the north and end at Tamil Nadu in the south.
 
• It includes the states of Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka Kerala, and Tamil Nadu.

questions.question: Temperate grasslands are ideal for ______ cultivation.
questions.solution:
Correct Answer **wheat**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__****Grassland :**

 
• Grassland can be defined as a region where grasses form the dominant type of plant life.
 
• Grasslands make up almost a quarter of the total land surface. 
 
• We can divide the world’s grasslands into two broad categories: those that occur in the temperate region and those that occur in the tropical regions.

**​Explanation:**

Temperate grasslands:

 
• These are found in the mid latitudinal zones and in the interior part of the continents.
 
• Usually, the grass here is short and nutritious.
 
• Temperate grasslands are ideal for grain cultivation.
 
• The grasslands provide fertile soil, adequate rainfall, and favorable temperatures for the growth of grains such as wheat, barley, oats, and rye.
 
• Wild buffaloes, bison, antelopes are common in the temperate region.
 
• Temperate grasslands are composed of a rich mix of grasses and forbs and are underlain by some of the world’s most fertile soils.
 
• Since the development of the steel plough, most have been converted to agricultural lands.
 
• The temperate grasslands of North America are known as the Prairies.
 
• It is a region of flat, gently sloping, or hilly land.
 
• For the most part, prairies are treeless but, near the low-lying plains, flanking river valleys, and woodlands can be found. 
 
• It is actually a “sea of grass.”
 
• The temperate grasslands of South Africa are called the velds.
 
• Temperate Grasslands of Argentina are called Pampas.

questions.question: Sundari trees are found in the ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Ganga-Brahmaputra delta.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **species of mangrove tree **found in the **Malvaceae family** is called ***Heritiera fomes*__. **
 
• **Sunder, sundri, jekanazo, and pinlekanazo** are some of its common names.
 
• It makes up around **70% of the trees **in the **Sundarbans of Bangladesh and India** and is the main type of mangrove tree there.
 
• **__*H. fomes*__** is a significant tree that** produces lumber.**
 
• The Sundari tree can be found in the **Ganga-Brahmaputra delta.**
 
• They are also known as the **Sunderbans** due to the large number of these trees in those areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahanadi delta:**

 
 
• **Mangroves and** their allies are found in great variety in the Mahanadi delta, which includes the districts of** Kendrapara, Jagatsinghpur, and Puri.**
 
• It is situated on India's east coast in the state of **Odisha.**
 
 
 
• **Godavari delta:**
 
 
• The States of **Telangana, Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, and Andhra Pradesh **make up this interstate subbasin.
 
• **Avicennia, Suaeda, Rhizophora, and Bruguiera species** are among the distinguishing trees; they are the **typical genera of Asia-Pacific mangroves.**
 
 
 
• **Muthupet delta:**
 
 
• In the southernmost tip of the **Cauvery river delta**, on the Gulf of Bengal, is** Muthupet Lagoon.**
 
• This beautiful area is usually green thanks to the **mangrove vegetation. **

questions.question: Which of the following statements about forests in INCORRECT?

options.text: In a forest, trees form the uppermost layer of vegetation.
Forests protect the soil from erosion.
In a forest, shrubs form the lowest layer of vegetation.
Forests influence climate, water cycle and air quality.

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is 'In a forest, shrubs form the lowest layer of vegetation.'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Forest Vegetation Layers:**

 
 
• Forests have a structured layering of vegetation. The layers, from top to bottom, include the canopy, understory, herb layer, and the forest floor.
 
• The uppermost layer is the **canopy**, formed by the crowns of tall trees.
 
• The **understory** is beneath the canopy and consists of smaller trees and shrubs.
 
• The **herb layer** is closer to the ground and includes grasses, ferns, wildflowers, and other herbaceous plants.
 
• The **forest floor** is the bottom layer, consisting of decomposing leaves, twigs, and organic matter.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Trees Form the Uppermost Layer:**

 
 
• Trees forming the uppermost layer of vegetation create the forest canopy, which is crucial for various ecological functions including providing habitat and influencing microclimate.
 
 
 
• **Forests and Soil Erosion:**
 
 
• Forests play a significant role in protecting soil from erosion through their root systems and ground cover, which stabilize the soil and prevent runoff.
 
 
 
• **Forests Influence Climate, Water Cycle, and Air Quality:**
 
 
• Forests have a major impact on the climate by absorbing carbon dioxide, influencing precipitation patterns, and through evapotranspiration processes.
 
• They also play a crucial role in the water cycle by facilitating the infiltration of water into the soil and maintaining watershed health.
 
• Forests contribute significantly to air quality by acting as carbon sinks, producing oxygen, and filtering pollutants from the air.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The lowest layer of vegetation in a forest is typically called the herb or ground layer, composed of low-growing non-woody plants like grasses, ferns, and mosses.
 
• Shrubs are usually found in the understory layer, which is above the ground layer but below the canopy.

questions.question: In which type of forests are Mahogany, Rosewood and Cinchona trees found in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tropical Evergreen forests**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahogany, Rosewood, and Cinchona trees** are typically found in **Tropical Evergreen forests** in India.
 
• Tropical Evergreen forests are characterized by **high rainfall, usually above 200 cm annually, and a warm climate.**
 
• These forests are dense, multi-layered, and host a diverse range of flora and fauna.
 
• They are primarily found in regions such as the **Western Ghats, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, and parts of northeastern India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tropical Evergreen forests are also known as **rainforests** due to their lush, green appearance throughout the year.
 
• The continuous canopy in these forests allows little sunlight to reach the ground, resulting in a sparse undergrowth.
 
• These forests play a crucial role in maintaining ecological balance and are vital for biodiversity conservation.
 
• Other notable trees found in **Tropical Evergreen forests include ebony, rubber, and bamboo**.

questions.question: In which of the following states of India is the buffalo breed named 'Banni' mainly reared?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **T**____**he buffalo breed named 'Banni' is mainly reared in Gujarat**__.
 
• **Banni buffalo**, which are also known as "Kutchi" or "Kundi", is a breed of buffalo found primarily in the Kutch district of Gujarat, India.
 
 
• The word 'Banni' is specific to not only the buffaloes but as well as the pasture grass species which are native to this region.[2] This breed of buffaloes is usually bred and preserved by a local community found in Kutch, called the 'Maldharis'.
 
• An average Banni buffalo yields around 12 to 18 liters of milk each day.
 
• The Banni buffalo has a different genetic makeup as compared to more common breeds, which allows for longer lactation periods, higher milk production potentials and also makes it disease resistant.

questions.question: Which type of forest receives more than 200 cm of annual rainfall?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Tropical evergreen forests** are found in places with high temperatures and heavy rainfall. They receive more than **200 cm** rainfall per year.
 
• These forests are also called tropical rainforests.
 
• These thick forests occur in the regions near the equator and close to the tropics.
 
• Region: Amazon Basin, Congo Basin
 
• These regions are hot and receive heavy rainfall throughout the year.
 
• There is no particular dry season so the trees do not shed their leaves altogether.
 
• Trees: Hardwood trees like rosewood, ebony, and mahogany.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Temperate mixed forests** are richest and most distinctive in central China and eastern North America, with some other globally distinctive ecoregions in the Caucasus, the Himalayas, Southern Europe, Australasia, Southwestern South America and the Russian Far East.
 
• **The taiga** is a forest of the cold, subarctic region. The subarctic is an area of the Northern Hemisphere that lies just south of the Arctic Circle.
 
 
• The taiga lies between the tundra to the north and temperate forests to the south.
 
 
 
• **Tundra **is found in the regions just below the ice caps of the Arctic, extending across North America, to Europe, and Siberia in Asia. Much of Alaska and about half of Canada are in the tundra biome.
 
 
• Tundra is also found at the tops of very high mountains elsewhere in the world.
